title: Hadrian platform panel
description: A spec-sheet panel framed in a 1px gold hairline: a wide media strip across the top, then a row split one to three by a gold rule, a small gold mono label on the left and a large, tight grotesk paragraph on the right (stacked on phones). The panel fades up as it enters view.
notes: opaque (bg-background) so it slides over a pinned hero
media strip is 16:9 on phones and 2.75:1 from 1024px; pass a video or image (object-cover)
the reveal is a CSS view() timeline; without support it simply shows
